input: What is the torque spec for the housing bolts on line 3?
context: Work Instruction WI-3-207 Rev D: Torque the four housing bolts to 25 Nm in a cross pattern. Verify with the calibrated torque wrench and record the value on the traveler. Revision C values are obsolete.

input: What do I do when I find a nonconforming part at inspection?
context: Quality Procedure QP-8.7: Tag the part with a red hold tag and move it to the quarantine area. Open an NCR in the QMS within the same shift. Only a quality engineer may decide the disposition.

input: How often is the coordinate measuring machine calibrated?
context: Calibration Procedure CAL-02: The CMM is calibrated every 12 months by an accredited lab and verified with a reference artifact at the start of each week. A failed weekly check stops all CMM measurements until resolved.

input: What steps come before clearing a jam in the stamping press?
context: Safety Procedure SP-LOTO-04: Before clearing a jam, bring the press to a full stop, apply your personal lock and tag at the main disconnect, release stored energy, and try the start button to verify zero energy.

input: What is the shelf life of the two-part epoxy adhesive?
context: Material Specification MS-114: The two-part epoxy has a shelf life of 9 months from the manufacture date when stored at 5 to 25 C. Expired material must be scrapped and may not be extended without a quality engineer approval.

input: Who must approve a change to a released work instruction?
context: Document Control Procedure DC-03: Changes to released work instructions need approval from the process engineer and the quality engineer. Operators are trained on the new revision before it becomes effective.
